codes.name: ABSORPTION_ESTIMATE_UNAVAILABLE
codes.explanation: You gave a specimen radius or thickness, but the package could not estimate the absorption from it.
codes.condition: A capillary radius or plate thickness was declared and the absorption estimate recorded why it was skipped (`record.skipped`).
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: ABSORPTION_MU_R_OUT_OF_RANGE
codes.explanation: The estimated absorption of the capillary lies beyond the range of the published fit used to correct it.
codes.condition: The estimated µR lies past `CYLINDER_MU_R_MAX`, the end of the published fit the capillary correction uses.
codes.kind_reason: The published fit's range is a fact about the correction, not a judgement about the data.

codes.name: ABSORPTION_PLATE_THICKNESS

guards: record.method == 'flat_plate_transmission' and record.intensity_fraction_of_optimal is not None and (record.intensity_fraction_of_optimal < 0.7)

codes.explanation: A transmission plate gives the most counts at one thickness, set by its absorption.
codes.condition: Under `flat_plate_transmission`, the declared thickness gives under 0.7 of the counts the optimal thickness would (the inline literal 0.7).
codes.kind_reason: The fraction of the optimal counts is arithmetic on the declared µt; the threshold decides only when it is said, and the code suggests nothing.
codes.note: Gated by an inline literal (0.7), one of the two the WP names.

codes.name: ABSORPTION_THICKNESS_MATTERS
codes.explanation: For a flat specimen the absorption correction depends on the thickness you declared.
codes.condition: Under a flat-plate geometry, the declared thickness moves the equivalent Biso by more than `FLAT_PLATE_BIAS_MIN`.
codes.kind_reason: The equivalent ΔBiso is arithmetic on the declared µt; the threshold decides only when it is said.

codes.name: ADP_NOT_POSITIVE_DEFINITE
codes.explanation: A refined anisotropic displacement tensor has a negative eigenvalue, so it does not describe an ellipsoid.
codes.condition: A refined anisotropic displacement tensor has a negative eigenvalue (`staged.check_adp_positive_definite`).
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.
codes.note: Raised from a guard finding; its test is in `strategy/staged.py` (WP-2002's walk).

codes.name: AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED

guards: not (model.bkg_penalty is None or any((p.endswith('background.air') for p in model.bkg_paths)))
not (fraction < AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED_FRACTION or removed / stats.chi2 < AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED_SCORE)

codes.explanation: The spline background declares no term for air scatter.
codes.condition: A spline background with no air-scatter term, where a 1/(2θ) column would remove at least `AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED_FRACTION` of χ² at a score of at least `AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED_SCORE`.
codes.kind_reason: Issue #1215 names a second explanation, a background too stiff at the low edge; the alternatives are enumerable and a refit scores each, while the code names one.
codes.note: Issue #1215 (in the WP's Inherited): fires on 20/20 clean synthetic patterns under the P-spline, by the issue's count.

codes.name: BACKGROUND_ABSORPTION
codes.explanation: The background is flexible enough to reproduce most of the effect of a structural parameter, such as a scale or a displacement parameter.
codes.condition: The projection R² of a structural column onto the background span exceeds `staged.BACKGROUND_ABSORPTION_GUARD` (0.25).
codes.kind_reason: Whether a given overlap biases the quantity the caller wants depends on the purpose, which the pattern does not carry.
codes.note: Threshold in `strategy/staged.py` (WP-2002's walk), unaudited there.

codes.name: BACKGROUND_ORDER_AT_CAP
codes.explanation: The scan for the Chebyshev order reached its largest allowed order.
codes.condition: The Chebyshev order scan ended at `CHEBYSHEV_MAX_ORDER` without its Durbin-Watson stop firing.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: BISO_NEGATIVE
codes.explanation: A refined isotropic displacement parameter is below zero.
codes.condition: A refined isotropic displacement parameter is below zero (`staged.check_biso_negative`).
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.
codes.note: Raised from a guard finding in `strategy/staged.py`.

codes.name: BISO_UNUSUALLY_LARGE
codes.explanation: A refined isotropic displacement parameter exceeds the amplitude at which a solid with this cell would melt.
codes.condition: A refined Biso exceeds the Lindemann melting amplitude for the cell (`staged.LINDEMANN_RHO`).
codes.kind_reason: Static disorder or a wrong site can exceed the thermal bound in a sound model; which one holds is a fact about the sample.
codes.note: Raised from a guard finding; `LINDEMANN_RHO` is tier 2 there.

codes.name: BOUND_HIT
codes.explanation: The refined value finished on its minimum or maximum, and the data were pushing it further.
codes.condition: A refined value finished on a declared limit that carried load (`staged.bound_findings`).
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.
codes.note: Its tests are `staged.BOUND_HIT_*`, tiered in WP-2002's walk.

codes.name: BRINDLEY_OUTSIDE_REGIME
codes.explanation: A phase absorbs too strongly for the Brindley correction.
codes.condition: A phase's µR exceeds `qpa.BRINDLEY_MU_R_FENCE`, the regime the Brindley correction was published for.
codes.kind_reason: The regime is the correction's published range, a fact about the method.

codes.name: CAPILLARY_OFFSET_UNAVAILABLE

guards: not (not any((f'instrument.geometry.{name}' in locked for name in CAPILLARY_OFFSETS)))

codes.explanation: The capillary geometry has no goniometer radius, so the specimen-offset aberrations cannot be modelled and are held at zero.
codes.condition: A capillary geometry carries no goniometer radius, so the specimen-offset terms are held at zero.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: CELL_DEGENERATE_PROBE
codes.explanation: During the cell search the optimiser tried trial cells with zero or negative volume.
codes.condition: The solver tried at least one trial cell with zero or negative volume during the stage.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: CELL_RUNAWAY
codes.explanation: A free cell parameter left its safety window around the starting cell while the solver worked.
codes.condition: A free cell parameter left the window `CELL_SAFETY_FRACTION` / `CELL_SAFETY_ANGLE_DEG` around its starting value.
codes.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 3, approved); copied here, not re-judged.

codes.name: CONSTRAINT_ACTIVE
codes.explanation: In the final stage the optimiser held some steps against a built-in inequality constraint.
codes.condition: In the final stage the LM driver held at least one step against a built-in inequality (the Stephens cone or Γ_G² ≥ 1e-8).
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: COVARIANCE_DIRECTION_DISCARDED
codes.explanation: The data do not constrain one combination of several parameters.
codes.condition: The covariance build discarded a direction several parameters share (`staged.check_discarded_directions`).
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

codes.name: COVARIANCE_UNAVAILABLE
codes.explanation: The solver returned, but the calculation of the esds raised an error afterwards.
codes.condition: The solver returned and the esd calculation raised afterwards.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: DATA_SUPPORT_LOW

guards: ratio is not None and ratio < OBS_PER_PARAMETER_PREFERRED

codes.explanation: The number of independent reflections is low compared with the number of structural parameters refined.
codes.condition: Independent reflections per structural parameter fall below `OBS_PER_PARAMETER_PREFERRED` (info) or `OBS_PER_PARAMETER_MIN` (warning).
codes.kind_reason: The count is arithmetic and the bands are quoted from the literature (CLAUDE.md, WP-1071); they set the level alone.

codes.name: DECLARED_RANGE_NOT_RESTORED
codes.explanation: An older release stored this parameter with no limits, because it was set by hand.
codes.condition: An older file stored a hand-set parameter with no limits, and migration found no declared range to restore.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: DECLARED_RANGE_RESTORED
codes.explanation: An older release stored this parameter with no limits, because it was set by hand.
codes.condition: An older file stored a hand-set parameter with no limits, and migration restored its declared range (a warning where the value sits on it).
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: DISPERSION_NEGLECTED
codes.explanation: The model has anomalous scattering turned off, yet at this wavelength it changes the scattering power of at least one element noticeably.
codes.condition: Anomalous scattering is off, and |f|² at this wavelength differs from Z² by at least `DISPERSION_NEGLECT_FRAC` for some element (a warning from `DISPERSION_NEGLECT_SEVERE`).
codes.kind_reason: The relative change is arithmetic on tabulated f′ and f″; the thresholds set when and how loudly.

codes.name: EXTRA_PEAK_NO_INTENSITY

guards: not (area <= 0.0 and area_path not in moving)

codes.explanation: The area of a declared peak finished at zero.
codes.condition: A declared extra peak's area finished on its zero floor (`BOUND_HIT_RTOL`).
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

codes.name: EXTRA_PEAK_ON_REFLECTION

guards: not (area <= 0.0 and area_path not in moving)

codes.explanation: A declared peak lies close enough to a reflection the model already predicts that the two describe one peak between them.
codes.condition: A declared extra peak lies within `LAYER0_MATCH_TOL_DEG` (0.08°) of a predicted reflection.
codes.kind_reason: A duplicate of the reflection and an impurity line at nearly the same angle are both possible, and a refit with and without the peak scores them.
codes.note: The tolerance is a fixed angle, not a fraction of the local FWHM.

codes.name: FLAT_DIRECTION
codes.explanation: Two parameters are correlated so completely that the data measure only one combination of them.
codes.condition: Two free parameters are correlated at or above `staged.FLAT_DIRECTION_RHO` (1 − 5e-4).
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.
codes.note: `FLAT_DIRECTION_RHO` is tier 1 in WP-2002's walk.

codes.name: FLOOR_HIT
codes.explanation: A scale, a width or a similar quantity finished on its lower limit of zero, because the data push it lower than it can go.
codes.condition: A scale, width or similar quantity finished on its zero floor and the data push it lower (`staged.bound_findings`).
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

codes.name: FROZEN_COMPILE_STALE
codes.explanation: The final stage fixes its peak windows at the values it started from.
codes.condition: A fresh compile at the returned parameters changes χ² by more than `FROZEN_COMPILE_CHI2_REL` of itself.
codes.kind_reason: The relative change is measured directly; the threshold decides only when it is said.

codes.name: HARMONIC_ABSENT
codes.explanation: A declared wavelength harmonic refined to a fraction indistinguishable from zero.
codes.condition: A declared harmonic's refined fraction is below `HARMONIC_ABSENT_FRAC`.
codes.kind_reason: Whether a fraction is distinguishable from zero is a statistical question the data settle; the code answers it with a fixed fraction rather than the esd, which is the threshold's question for part 2.
codes.note: An absolute fraction, not a significance test.

codes.name: HARMONIC_FRACTION
codes.explanation: A declared wavelength harmonic refined to a measurable fraction of the fundamental.
codes.condition: A declared harmonic refined to a measurable fraction; a warning above `HARMONIC_IMPLAUSIBLE_FRAC`.
codes.kind_reason: Whether a fraction is plausible depends on the monochromator and the detector's energy window, facts outside the pattern.

codes.name: HARMONIC_HELD
codes.explanation: The weight of a declared wavelength harmonic was held, so it did not enter the fit.
codes.condition: A declared harmonic's weight was not free, so it did not enter the fit.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: HIGH_CORRELATION
codes.explanation: Two refined parameters are strongly correlated, so the data constrain their combination better than either one alone.
codes.condition: Two free parameters are correlated above the stage's `correlation_guard` (`schemas.plan.CORRELATION_GUARD`, 0.98).
codes.kind_reason: Whether a correlation of this size harms the quantity the caller wants depends on the purpose; WP-2037's response column is the package's answer to that.
codes.note: The threshold is in `schemas/plan.py` (WP-2002's walk), unaudited there; B13 handed it here.

codes.name: HOLD_BLOCKED_PLAN
codes.explanation: A stage of the plan asked to refine a parameter that you had held.
codes.condition: A stage's `turn_on` glob matched a parameter the caller had held, so it stayed fixed.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: HUMP_TOO_NARROW
codes.explanation: A declared background peak has narrowed towards the instrumental resolution.
codes.condition: A declared background hump narrowed below `staged.HUMP_MIN_WIDTH_MULT` times the instrumental width.
codes.kind_reason: An unindexed Bragg line and a real narrow diffuse feature are both possible, and the data can score a peak against a hump.
codes.note: `HUMP_MIN_WIDTH_MULT` is in `strategy/staged.py`, unaudited; B13 handed it here.

codes.name: LEBAIL_ALTERNATION_STOPPED
codes.explanation: A Le Bail fit alternates between extracting intensities and refining the other parameters.
codes.condition: The Le Bail alternation stopped; info when it converged, a warning for any other reason.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: LEBAIL_CYCLES_AT_CAP

guards: not (last is None or last.lebail_settled is not False)

codes.explanation: The partition repeats until the intensities stop moving, under the cap `lebail_cycles`.
codes.condition: The intensity partition reached the cap `lebail_cycles` before the intensities stopped moving.
codes.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

codes.name: LOW_ANGLE_UNMODELLED
codes.explanation: The region below the first reflection has a larger residual than the rest of the pattern.
codes.condition: Below the first reflection less two FWHM, the mean (Δ/σ)² over at least `LOW_ANGLE_MIN_CHANNELS` channels exceeds `LOW_ANGLE_UNMODELLED_RATIO` times χ²_red.
codes.kind_reason: Issue #1219 names three competent responses (air scatter, a beam-stop cut, a real diffuse component), and which applies depends on the measurement, outside the pattern.
codes.note: Two inline literals: the 2 FWHM region edge and the 2σ channel test that places the suggested lower limit. Issue #1219 proposes dropping the suggestion.

codes.name: MAGNETIC_WIDTH_MOVED_MOMENT
codes.explanation: Freeing the magnetic broadening moved the refined moment by more than its esd.
codes.condition: Freeing the magnetic broadening moved a released moment by more than `MAGNETIC_WIDTH_MOMENT_SHIFT_SIGMA` esds.
codes.kind_reason: The shift is measured in its own esd; the threshold decides only when it is said.

codes.name: MICROABSORPTION_SKIPPED
codes.explanation: A particle radius was given for at least one phase, but the correction could not run.
codes.condition: A particle radius was given for at least one phase and the Brindley correction could not run (`qpa.microabsorption_skipped`).
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: MODEL_FAR_FROM_DATA
codes.explanation: Rwp is so high that the model does no better than one that predicts no intensity.
codes.condition: Rwp exceeds `MODEL_FAR_FROM_DATA_RWP` (0.8), at an error level.
codes.kind_reason: No competent refiner reads an Rwp near that of a model predicting no intensity as a fit; the threshold row is tier 3 on its own.
codes.note: Error level: a series escalates and quarantines on it (WP-2003, the WP's Inherited).

codes.name: NEUTRON_RESONANT_ABSORBER
codes.explanation: The structure contains an element whose scattering length is complex and varies with wavelength near a nuclear resonance.
codes.condition: Under a neutron source, the structure holds an element with a complex scattering length near a resonance; a warning from `RESONANT_ABSORBER_SEVERE_BARN`.
codes.kind_reason: The tabulated absorption is a nuclear fact; the threshold sets the level alone.

codes.name: OCCUPANCY_ABOVE_ONE

guards: not (path not in moving or occ is None or (not occ > 1.0))

codes.explanation: A refined site occupancy is above 1, so the model puts more scatterers on the site than it holds.
codes.condition: A refined site occupancy is above 1.
codes.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 3 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.
codes.note: No significance gate; whether to add one is the maintainer's (WP-2002's handover, in the WP's Inherited).

codes.name: ORIGIN_FIXED_ON_POLAR_AXIS
codes.explanation: The space group has an axis along which shifting every atom changes no intensity, so the data cannot fix the position along it.
codes.condition: The space group is polar and the package held the origin along the polar axis (`_origin_diagnostics`, `_centroid_finding`).
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: ORIGIN_NOT_FIXED
codes.explanation: The space group has an axis along which the whole structure can slide without changing any intensity.
codes.condition: The space group is polar and nothing holds the origin along its polar axis.
codes.kind_reason: Symmetry fixes it.

codes.name: PATTERN_DEAD_CHANNELS
codes.explanation: A short run of channels reads far below the local background, and its error bars shrank with it.
codes.condition: With a measured σ, a short run of fitted channels reads far below the local background and its σ shrank with it (`background.diagnostics.dead_channels`).
codes.kind_reason: Counts below a smooth background with σ shrinking alongside are a detector fault; no diffraction physics produces the pair.
codes.note: Thresholds in `background/diagnostics.py` (WP-2002's walk).

codes.name: PATTERN_UNDERSAMPLED

guards: steps is not None and steps < STEPS_PER_FWHM_MIN

codes.explanation: The typical peak is covered by too few measured points across its width.
codes.condition: The typical peak spans fewer than `STEPS_PER_FWHM_MIN` points per FWHM.
codes.kind_reason: The band is quoted from the literature (tier 2); it sets the level alone.

codes.name: PAWLEY_OFF_DATA_RIDGED

guards: not (pb is None or not pb.off_data)

codes.explanation: Some reflections have no emission line centred inside the fitted data.
codes.condition: Some Pawley reflections have no emission line centred inside the fitted data, and their intensities are ridged.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: PAWLEY_OVERLAP_UNRESOLVED

guards: not (pb is None or pb.stderr is None or (not pb.groups))

codes.explanation: Several reflections overlap so strongly that the data fix their summed intensity but not how it divides among them.
codes.condition: In an overlap group the largest esd/|I| reaches `PAWLEY_UNRESOLVED_REL`.
codes.kind_reason: The relative esd is measured; the threshold decides only when it is said.

codes.name: PHASE_UNCONSTRAINED

guards: not (not (unconstrained or held or lacks or instrument_held))
not (n_phases < 2 and (not (held or lacks or instrument_held)))

codes.explanation: The scale of a phase is too close to zero for the data to tell it from an absent phase, or none of its reflections lie in the fitted range.
codes.condition: A phase with free non-scale paths, held paths or no measured scale has a scale under `PHASE_SUPPORT_SIGMA` of its counting-noise esd, or no line in range (a single-phase model only where something was held); the message says what was held, the instrument included.
codes.kind_reason: The hold passes the judgement ground (milestone § The rule); only its 3σ is on trial, and that is WP-2002's.
codes.note: The action is WP-2002's; this WP owns the code.

codes.name: PLAN_FREES_NO_MOMENT
codes.explanation: The structure carries a magnetic moment and no stage of the plan frees it.
codes.condition: The structure carries a magnetic moment and no stage of the plan frees it.
codes.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

codes.name: QPA_ESD_UNAVAILABLE
codes.explanation: A phase scale refined to a value at which its uncertainty could not be measured, usually zero.
codes.condition: A phase scale refined to a value where its esd could not be measured.
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

codes.name: QPA_UNAVAILABLE
codes.explanation: The refined scales, weighted by the cell contents, sum to zero or less, so there is nothing to normalise into weight fractions.
codes.condition: The weighted scales sum to zero or less, so no weight fractions exist.
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

codes.name: RESOLUTION_NOT_POSITIVE
codes.explanation: An instrument width is negative somewhere in the fitted range.
codes.condition: An instrument width is negative somewhere in the fitted range (`staged.check_resolution_positive`).
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

codes.name: RESOLUTION_UNCONSTRAINED
codes.explanation: The Gaussian resolution terms were refined on a pattern whose peaks are mostly Lorentzian.
codes.condition: Gaussian resolution terms were free while more than half the fitted channels are Lorentzian-dominated (`staged.check_resolution_supported`).
codes.kind_reason: The Lorentzian share is arithmetic on the refined widths.
codes.note: The 'more than half' is an inline literal in `strategy/staged.py` (`lorentzian.sum() * 2 <= tt.size`), outside this WP's file.

codes.name: RESTRAINT_PAIRS_STALE
codes.explanation: At the end of the run, a phase's anti-bump restraints were checked against the final coordinates, and some contacts closer than their minimum distance have no row in the pair list.
codes.condition: At the end of the run a phase's anti-bump restraints missed contacts closer than their minimum distance.
codes.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

codes.name: RESTRAINT_TENSION
codes.explanation: A soft restraint, such as a bond length, finished well away from its target in units of its own uncertainty.
codes.condition: A soft restraint finished more than `RESTRAINT_TENSION_SIGMA` of its own σ from its target.
codes.kind_reason: Whether the restraint or the data is wrong depends on chemistry outside the pattern.

codes.name: RIGID_BODY_UNSUPPORTED
codes.explanation: A free rotation or shift of a rigid body has no effect on the pattern.
codes.condition: A free rotation or shift of a rigid body has a zero column.
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

codes.name: ROUGHNESS_ABSORPTION
codes.explanation: Surface roughness cannot be separated from the displacement parameters, the scale and the background over this range.
codes.condition: The roughness column's projection R² onto displacement, scale and background exceeds `staged.ROUGHNESS_ABSORPTION_GUARD` (0.9).
codes.kind_reason: As for `BACKGROUND_ABSORPTION`: whether the overlap harms the quantity wanted depends on the purpose.
codes.note: Threshold in `strategy/staged.py`, unaudited there.

codes.name: ROUGHNESS_OUTSIDE_REGIME

guards: not (model.roughness is None or not len(model.tt))
not (model.roughness is None or not len(model.tt))

codes.explanation: The Pitschke roughness model holds only above a limiting angle that depends on its parameter.
codes.condition: Under the Pitschke model, τ exceeds sin θ_min (a warning) or half of it (info).
codes.kind_reason: The model's regime is from its paper; the half that sets the info band is an inline literal.
codes.note: Inline literal 0.5 for the info band.

codes.name: ROUGHNESS_UNCONSTRAINED

guards: not (model.roughness is None or not len(model.tt))

codes.explanation: The refined roughness correction changes the intensity of every modelled reflection by almost nothing.
codes.condition: The refined roughness changes every modelled reflection's intensity by less than `ROUGHNESS_MIN_DEPRESSION`.
codes.kind_reason: The depression is arithmetic on the refined model; the threshold decides only when it is said.

codes.name: SCALE_B_INSEPARABLE
codes.explanation: Over the fitted range the scale of a phase and its displacement parameters act on the data in the same way.
codes.condition: Over the fitted range a phase's scale and Biso columns separate by less than `SCALE_B_SEPARATION_FLOOR`.
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.
codes.note: `SCALE_B_SEPARATION_FLOOR` is tier 1 (2√rcond).

codes.name: SITE_DOFS_RENUMBERED
codes.explanation: A site's coordinates moved onto or off a special position so that its coordinate degrees of freedom changed (`dof.1` is y on the general position and z on a mirror at y = 1/4, in either direction), and a hold, tie or free path sat on one of them.
codes.condition: A site moved onto or off a special position and a hold, tie or free path sat on one of its renumbered DOFs.
codes.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

codes.name: SIZE_UNUSUALLY_SMALL

guards: not (coeff is None or not coeff > 0.0)

codes.explanation: A phase's refined size broadening implies a crystallite size below the range seen in solved refinements.
codes.condition: A phase's size broadening implies a crystallite size below `SIZE_FLAG_SIZE_A` (Scherrer, `SCHERRER_K`).
codes.kind_reason: A small crystallite is a real outcome of synthesis or milling; whether it is a defect depends on the sample.
codes.note: Calibrated on one 1 213-record archive (the WP's Families): one family.

codes.name: SPECIES_FALLBACK_NEUTRAL

guards: not (delta is not None and abs(delta) < SPECIES_FALLBACK_MIN_DELTA_FRAC)

codes.explanation: The ion named for a site has no entry in the form-factor table.
codes.condition: An ion named for a site has no form-factor entry, so the neutral atom's was used.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: STAGE_FREES_MAGNETIC_WIDTH_WITH_MOMENT
codes.explanation: A stage frees the magnetic broadening in the same stage that first frees the moment.
codes.condition: A stage frees the magnetic broadening in the stage that first frees the moment.
codes.kind_reason: The two orders are enumerable and a refit of each scores them; the code asserts one.

codes.name: STAGE_MAX_ITER
codes.explanation: A stage ran out of iterations before it converged.
codes.condition: A stage ran out of iterations before it converged.
codes.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

codes.name: STAGE_NOT_FINITE
codes.explanation: The model held a NaN or an infinity at a point the solver reached, so the solver had no step left to take.
codes.condition: The model held a NaN or an infinity at a point the solver reached.
codes.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

codes.name: STAGE_PATH_NOT_FREE
codes.explanation: A stage asked to refine a parameter that symmetry or the model fixes, or that follows another parameter.
codes.condition: A stage asked to refine a path that symmetry or the model fixes, or that follows another.
codes.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

codes.name: STAGE_PATH_UNKNOWN
codes.explanation: A stage asked to refine a parameter by a name that no parameter of the model has.
codes.condition: A stage named a path no parameter of the model has.
codes.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

codes.name: STAGE_SLOW_DESCENT
